items.summary: Raw sugar futures have reached their highest level since March 2025. Strong Indian import demand and Brazilian supply disruptions are driving these gains. India has opened a tax-free import quota to meet domestic needs. The government warns mills against unjustified price increases during festivals. items.summary: Amitabh Dube has been appointed as the new president of OPPI for a two-year term. Dube currently serves as the Country President and Managing Director of Novartis India. items.summary: India's clothing retail market is projected to achieve a growth rate of twelve to thirteen percent in the current fiscal year, a slight decrease from the fifteen percent growth seen last year.
